description.value:
A chronoculus eye is an ocular implant that allows you to see in a wide spectrum of wavelengths as well as partially predict the future. You gain darkvision, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of your level or lower, and you gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative.

Activate—Wide-Spectrum Scan 1

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Until the start of your next turn, you gain the effects of a 7th-rank truesight spell and can see infrared and ultraviolet light as well as all other wavelengths of light and radiation.

Activate—Future Sight r (fortune)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail or critically fail an attack roll or saving throw

Effect You roll the triggering attack roll or saving throw again, taking the second result.
